Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1141
Claimant:
Dylan Jackson
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
01/06/2025
First notice of loss received for a low-speed collision in a parking lot involving the insured vehicle and a second
vehicle. The claimant reports a wrist fracture and is represented by counsel, so all further contact will go through the
attorney's office.
01/09/2025
Reviewed the police report and statements from two witnesses along with photos from the scene. Both witnesses and
the other driver describe the accident the same way, and the claimant is confirmed as being in the vehicle at the time.
04/23/2025
Inspected the insured vehicle and the damage matches the impact described by all parties. No earlier damage to the
vehicle is known, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the coverage period. The driver is named on
the policy.
04/26/2025
Medical records show the wrist fracture was treated along a usual course, with care tapering off as the patient
improved. It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash, since prior records show a small strain in the
same area years ago that healed fully.
06/16/2025
The claimant has given the same account of the accident in every conversation so far. Requested the full prior
medical history through counsel to help determine causation.
06/17/2025
Next step is to obtain an independent medical review of the records before making any decision on the bodily injury
portion of the claim. Reserve remains open pending that review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
